messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! friend works, but i need your actual name to find you the right roles

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man... or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
Adnaan Khan

adnaan khan... solid name, sounds like someone who gets things done

where you working these days?
Yes
ai & data analytics at kpmg... building the future while wearing a suit. that's the sweet spot where consulting meets actual tech innovation. what made you jump into the ai game at a big 4?
KPMG Canada

kpmg canada... the big 4 consulting life, eh? ai & data analytics - that's where the money's moving these days

found you on linkedin: https://ca.linkedin.com/in/adnaankhan98

this you?
Loved working in AI needed a job got it looking for a switch

fair enough. classic move - love the tech, needed the paycheck, now ready to level up. consulting's great for learning but terrible for actually building cool stuff.

how long you been working total?
3 years

3 years... perfect timing to escape the big 4 before you get too comfortable with those consulting day rates

what kind of role you looking for next?
Want to move into Product Management

product management... from ai consulting to building products. smart pivot - you've got the technical depth and client-facing skills. pm roles love ex-consultants who actually understand the tech

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to remote
3 years experience + product management + open to remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yup

yooo welcome to the tal fam! 

you're officially in the system now. from kpmg consultant to product legend... that journey starts here

roles that actually match your vibe will slide into your dms. no more scrolling through naukri wondering if "5-7 years experience" includes your consulting time (it does, btw)

time to build products that matter instead of powerpoints that don't ✨

hey, zendesk's looking for a product manager for their data platform

data platform work could be a smooth pivot from your AI & data analytics experience
